description: Elections Commission - M. N. M. Infan of the Kotikawatta, Mulleriyawa Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of the member of United National Party - T. A. D. Sudarshanee Malkanthi Jayathilaka of the Kotikawatta Mulleriyawa Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated her office of the member of the United National Party
reasoning: This gazette contains a notice under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their office as members of a local authority (Pradeshiya Sabha) due to ceasing membership in a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) rather than government personnel changes (which would be Types 1-3 for national government matters).
